name: Barbell Front Box Squat
steps: Stand just ahead of a flat bench with a barbell racked across your front shoulders, elbows lifted high, and feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core tightly and sit your hips smoothly back and down with your torso tall.
Touch down lightly on the bench and pause briefly without losing upper-back tightness.
Drive forcefully through your feet to stand straight back up with your elbows pointing high.
tips: Avoid rocking backward or relaxing your core when your hips contact the bench.
Keep your elbows high so the bar stays locked in place across your front delts.
